recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not add redundant prose or restore standalone core elements; future changes to the claim information category code system should proceed through UTG/THO rather than this closed core tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-13826 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3. The request began as allowing a boolean value for ExplanationOfBenefit.hospitalization; the final resolution removed the standalone Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit hospitalization and EmploymentImpacted elements, represented those facts through the information/supportingInfo structure using claim information category codes, and added boolean as an allowed information value.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged application is git commit 4a2f618cfd6a35e6bf8445eab10ac7310da3de6c, Tracker #13826, which changed Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit source/examples and added hospitalized and employmentimpacted to the claim information category code system. Later refactors renamed information to supportingInfo, and commit 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8 moved the code system content out of core as part of the UTG/THO terminology migration.
additional_context: Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current source has Claim.supportingInfo.category and ExplanationOfBenefit.supportingInfo.category bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/claim-informationcategory, examples use http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/claiminformationcategory with hospitalized and employmentimpacted, and no Claim/ExplanationOfBenefit hospitalization or employmentImpacted elements remain. Published THO terminology still defines hospitalized and employmentimpacted with definitions that allow a period if known or a Yes/No boolean otherwise. UP-691 is a later unresolved UTG proposal draft for broader code-system harmonization and is not a final decision that changes this issue.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current build-scope Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit sources already implement the final Jira disposition, and core correctly references the THO terminology source of truth for the relevant category codes.

related_jiras.note: Unresolved UTG proposal draft for broader claim information category harmonization; it mentions the same code system but is not a final source-edit decision for this core issue.
